root_cause.text: In `btrfs_commit_transaction()` the block group root was incorrectly unconditionally inserted into `cur_trans->switch_commits` even though `block_group_root` already participates in normal dirty-root tracking via `dirty_list`, so `list_add_tail()` on an already-linked `dirty_list` corrupted the Btrfs transaction lists.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `EXTENT_TREE_V2` block that did `list_add_tail(&fs_info->block_group_root->dirty_list, &cur_trans->switch_commits);`, and the CVE text says the block group tree “will already be linked to a list by the dirty_list field” and that this “use of list_add_tail() is invalid and corrupts the prev/next members of block_group_root->dirty_list.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the EXTENT_TREE_V2-specific block group root commit handling from transaction commit processing.
intent_record.what: The diff removes an `if (btrfs_fs_incompat(fs_info, EXTENT_TREE_V2))` block from `btrfs_commit_transaction()`. That block previously updated `fs_info->block_group_root->root_item` with `btrfs_set_root_node(...)` and added `fs_info->block_group_root->dirty_list` to `cur_trans->switch_commits` before calling `switch_commit_roots(trans)`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, `btrfs_commit_transaction()` no longer performs a special-case commit-time refresh and enqueue of the block group root when `EXTENT_TREE_V2` is enabled. The transaction commit now proceeds without explicitly marking that root dirty in this path, which changes which roots are switched/committed during the transaction.

grouping_result.intent: Remove the EXTENT_TREE_V2-specific block group root commit handling from transaction commit processing.

relevance_review.reason: The change removes EXTENT_TREE_V2 block group root commit handling from transaction commit processing, which directly matches the root cause of incorrectly adding block_group_root to transaction commit lists and corrupting list state.

candidates.rationale: This unconditionally enqueued block_group_root on cur_trans->switch_commits even though block_group_root was already linked through dirty_list tracking, so adding it again could corrupt the transaction list.

This is part of the block_group_root commit handling that was executed in the vulnerable path before the fix; together with the list_add_tail call it contributed to incorrectly re-adding an already-linked root.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement unconditionally added block_group_root to cur_trans->switch_commits even though block_group_root was already tracked via dirty_list, causing list corruption by linking an already-linked list node.
